description: 3,333 antique clockwork machine NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-only minting through a Binance Agentic Wallet agent.

mint.description: How an AI agent mints a RUVEQ NFT for a Binance Agentic Wallet user.

steps.description: Read https://ruveq.vercel.app/llms.txt and the agent prompt on https://ruveq.vercel.app/ (homepage, #agent-prompt section)
Confirm the user's wallet holds a SPACE ID Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F)
Read currentPrice() on the live contract 0x1bd0554899b1cbadb3ac68b95a72fa5320d52a21 — never hardcode a price
Call mint() with no arguments and exactly currentPrice() as value, show the exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing, then confirm on-chain
